description:
During this year's CES, Razer declared that the "future of gaming is AI," which led to a backlash on the company's social media channels. Razer CEO Min-Liang Tan hasn't backed down from his company's stance, but he has offered an explanation that clarifies where it stands on AI in game development.

"'What are we unhappy with?' When I say we, I mean us as gamers," Tan told The Verge. "I think we're unhappy with generative AI slop, right? Just to put it out there. And that's something that I'm unhappy with. Like any gamer, when I play a game, I want to be engaged, I wanna be immersed, I wanna be able to be competitive. I don't want to be served character models with extra fingers and stuff like that, or shoddily written storylines, so on and so forth. I think for us, we're all aligned against gen AI slop th
title: Razer Boss Decries AI "Slop" But Is Still Bullish On AI In Games

After Amazon announced that its MMO New World would close down in January 2027, Alistair McFarlane--the director and COO at Rust studio Facepunch--made an "offer" of $25 million to buy the game. He has now confirmed this was a joke, but followed up to say he has actually spoken to current and former Amazon staff, adding that the team at Facepunch is "always looking at new opportunities."

"What started off as a joke between a colleague and me on X quickly took on a life of its own. I genuinely appreciate everyone who's reached out over the last few days, including current and former Amazon Games staff who have offered their support and insight,"
title: New World $25 Million Offer From Rust Dev Was A Joke But Studio Has Talked With Amazon

description:
World of Warcraft: Midnight's expansion pre-patch is out later today on January 20, and once it's live, many of the game's player-made mods for assisting in combat (add-ons) will look and function much differently than before. In some cases, they may not even work at all.

Announced early last year, Blizzard is finally ripping off the combat add-on Band-Aid today in an effort to make WoW more understandable out of the box and make it so add-ons don't offer distinct advantages in combat. For well over a decade, players doing endgame raids or high-level Mythic+ dungeons have always relied on combat add-ons to make the game easier to parse. Sometimes that meant specific boss callouts or solutions for certain boss mechanics. Other times it meant custom reminders on when to use specific abilities.
title: WoW Mods Are Changing Forever Today

description:
Rockstar North, the development studio behind Grand Theft Auto 6, was struck by an explosion earlier this week at its office in Edinburgh, Scotland. The explosion occurred at 5:02 AM local time on January 19, and it apparently took place in the facility's boiler room.

According to BNO News, the incident set off a small fire at Rockstar North's office, and emergency response crews were on the scene for four hours. No injuries were reported from the fire or explosion, and Rockstar issued a statement that thanked the first responders and assured fans that GTA 6 development wasn't affected.

"Many thanks to those that reached out with concern, and also to the police and fire crews who were on scene quickly to access the situation. Please know that everyone is well and our studio remains open and ope
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Developer's Office Rocked By An Explosion

description:
Deck Nine and Square Enix have officially revealed Life is Strange: Reunion after a tease last week and an Xbox Wire leak earlier today. It's out in March and is meant to serve as the culmination and conclusion of Max Caulfield and Chloe Price's story.

Yes, Chloe Price is returning in Life is Strange: Reunion after not appearing in 2024's Double Exposure, to the chagrin of the series' fan base. It'll follow the pair as they reunite following Max's merging of realities at the end of Double Exposure and Chloe's time either being dead or serving as a tour manager for a band called Drugstore Makeup.
title: Life Is Strange: Reunion Finally Brings Back Chloe Price

description:
While Fortnite is known to feature partnerships with outside IP for its Battle Royale, Lego Odyssey, and Fortnite Festival modes, every so often the focus will shift to Fortnite Islands--the game's robust custom map scene. Today, two of the community's top creators, Chartis and Teravision Games, have announced the next custom map collaboration will be with Wizards of the Coast, as Dungeons & Dragons makes its Fortnite debut with five maps featuring five unique experiences.

The five Dungeons & Dragons maps were created using Epic's UEFN engine, which contains tools within Unreal Engine specifically for creating new Fortnite experiences. The maps--which have been designed as a "launch and learn initiative" by Wizards of the Coast--include a social hub, PvP arena, and "the largest co-op roguelike in Fortnite history" as described by the official announcement.
title: Dungeons & Dragons Drops Into Fortnite With Five New Custom Maps

description:

Fortunately, you can do just that in the game, and that's something that Bandai Namco wants to remind prospective players with a new trailer featuring people in a classical spa while humanity teeters on the brink of collapse.

No, talkative guy in the spa, I do not want to chat after spending a day time-traveling and risking my digital skin in a post-apocalyptic landscape.
title: Code Vein 2 Has A Spa, So The Apocalypse Can Wait

In an interview with ReaderGrev, Cross feels like the state of funding for games has reached a point where studios shouldn't blindly fund games based on spec and compares Concord to Marathon on the same sort of production scale.

description:
After Nintendo warned it might happen, one analyst is now predicting that the Nintendo Switch 2 will see a global price hike in 2026. Daniel Ahmad of Niko Partners said the Switch 2 will follow the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S with its own price hike this year, due in part to tariffs, increased memory costs, and "broader economic conditions."

Ahmad said Nintendo stuck with the $450 price for the base model in 2025 despite the impact of tariffs in places like Vietnam, China, and Japan where Switch 2 units are produced. "More recently, increased demand for AI data centers has pushed RAM and storage prices up," Ahmad wrote.

He further when on to predict that Nintendo could also opt to discontinue the $450 Switch 2 model and only sell the $500 edition that includes Mario Kart World.
title: Switch 2 Will Get A Price Hike This Year, Expert Predicts

The two-minute clip shows a cyberpunk city giving off strong Blade Runner energy--one filled with neon lights and various NPCs. Among them are what looks to be alien species, further highlighting the game's sci-fi setting.

Former Nintendo of America president Doug Bowser has joined the board of directors at toy giant Hasbro, the company has announced. He's joining the board alongside Carla Vernón, the CEO of The Honest Company.

A VR mod for Cyberpunk 2077 was struck down with a DMCA by CD Projekt Red because the mod's creator was charging for it.

Luke Ross is a modder known for adding virtual reality support to games that do not natively have it. His Patreon subscribers pay him to access these mods, one of which was for Cyberpunk 2077. Earlier this month, though, CD Projekt Red issued a DMCA takedown, forcing Ross to remove the VR mod for this RPG that had previously been available.

CD Projekt Red's VP of Business Development Jan Rosner confirmed in a post on X that the mod was taken down because it was paid, referencing the company's fan content guidelines.

description:
In the five years since its release, Hitman: World of Assassination has hit multiple platforms, with Agent 47 infiltrating multiple PC storefronts, mobile devices, and even the original Switch through a cloud version of the game. In just a couple of weeks, players will be able to sync their progress across all platforms through cross-progression.

Developer IO Interactive marked the stealth-action game's fifth anniversary with a blog post detailing how cross-progression will work once the feature goes live on February 3. Challenge progression, inventory, and even achievements will be stored online, ensuring that your experiences with Agent 47 seamlessly carry over no matter which platform you play on.

The one caveat is that you can only pull from one "primary" save with cross-progression enabled. That's easy for anyone who perhaps owns Hitman on one platform
title: Hitman Is Getting Cross-Progression Soon As It Celebrates A Major Anniversary

Bartos said, "I'm deeply grateful for the opportunity to join such an inspiring group of people, and I can't wait to get started." Serving as a senior game producer, Bartos said his job will be to "help deliver an MMO experience players truly enjoy."

Additionally, Bartos said he's excited to join another former WoW developer, Orlando Salvatore, at Riot. "Given our track record on World of Warcraft, I have a feeling we'll be moving fast on day one," Bartos said.

Featuring fan-favorites from recent hits like Baldur's Gate 3 and Clair Obscur, TV sci-fi stars, and other notable gaming voices, Bungie is clearly going all-in on Marathon's voice acting.

In a blog post, Bungie revealed the 33 names that make up the English voice cast for Marathon, many of them instantly recognisable for fans of games and sci-fi.
